blocking_findings.title: Blocking CI job's event set and base discriminator are unspecified
blocking_findings.summary: ci.yml has three triggers (push:[main], pull_request, merge_group) and zero event guards ('grep -n "if:"' returns only 'if: failure()'). 'grep -rn event_name' across all five plan artifacts returns zero. D12's table, tasks.md:634 and work-packages.yaml:408 all say the blocking sweep is pull_request-triggered, which either makes the round-4 merge_group fix unreachable, or — with no guard, the repo convention — runs the job on push where no base exists and spec.md:520 makes that a hard failure, redding main on every push.

blocking_findings.title: merge_group diff spans every batched PR, so the ambiguity rule fails the queue
blocking_findings.summary: spec.md:524 says a diff touching more than one change directory SHALL fail as ambiguous. On merge_group the diff covers the whole group, so any two OpenSpec changes batched together fail the merge queue. Coupled to F1: whether this matters at all depends on whether the blocking job runs on merge_group.

blocking_findings.title: proposal.md contradicted D12, the spec delta, and its own risks table
blocking_findings.summary: proposal.md:229 stated as an acceptance criterion that the integration-branch sweep FAILS on violations, while the risks table in the same file says it 'reports them in full without blocking'. Both lines 65 and 229 attributed blocking to the integration branch rather than the merge candidate. Corrected.

blocking_findings.title: skill-workflow's no-hand-fill requirement had no owner
blocking_findings.summary: The hand-fill instruction lives in two source copies of the change-context.md template, neither covered by any package's write_allow. wp-matrix believed SKILL.md was the only copy. Added both paths to wp-matrix write_allow, named them in task 5.5, and added a verification step confirmed to FAIL on the unmodified tree (exit 1, naming both files).

escalation_reason: Round 5 returned not_converged with 4 blocking findings, all independently re-verified at the source. Orchestrator declined to raise the cap a third time.
